title: corydalis caseana subsp. brandegeei
intro: Corydalis caseana subsp. brandegeei, commonly known as Mexican Corydalis or Brandegee's Corydalis, is a perennial plant that belongs to the family Papaveraceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating conditions such as pain, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Corydalis caseana subsp. brandegeei include its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids and terpenoids, that exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects.
